title: A Hybrid Analytical-Neural Residual Surrogate for Fast Radio Propagation Prediction over Irregular Terrain
abstract: arXiv:2611.32698v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fast prediction of radio-wave propagation over irregular terrain is important for coverage analysis in mountainous environments, where many terrain and antenna configurations must be evaluated repeatedly. High-fidelity split-step parabolic equation (SSPE) solvers can capture terrain-induced shadowing and interference, but their computational cost is high for repeated planning studies. Learning-based surrogates reduce this cost, but direct field regression asks the network to learn both analytically tractable propagation trends and terrain-dependent residual structure. This paper proposes a hybrid analytical-neural residual surrogate that separates these two parts. A deterministic analytical baseline represents free-space spreading, antenna directivity, modified knife-edge diffraction, and terrain-aware specular reflection, while a compact coarse-to-fine neural network predicts the residual field. translated_title: 一种用于不规则地形上快速无线电传播预测的解析-神经混合残差代理模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.32698v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：在不规则地形上进行无线电波传播的快速预测，对于山区环境中的覆盖分析至关重要，因为需要对多种地形和天线配置进行反复评估。高精度的分步抛物方程（SSPE）求解器能够捕捉地形引起的阴影和干扰效应，但其计算成本对于反复的规划研究而言过高。基于学习的代理模型可以降低这一成本，但直接的场回归要求网络同时学习解析上可处理的传播趋势和依赖于地形的残差结构。本文提出了一种解析-神经混合残差代理模型，将这两个部分分离。确定性的解析基线表征自由空间扩散、天线方向性、改进的刀口衍射以及地形感知的镜面反射，而一个紧凑的由粗到细神经网络则预测残差场。该网络利用基线导出的引导（信息）……
tldr: 本文提出一种解析-神经混合残差代理模型，用确定性解析基线（涵盖自由空间扩散、天线方向性、刀口衍射和地形镜面反射）分离可解析的传播趋势，再由紧凑的由粗到细神经网络预测残差场，从而实现不规则地形上快速准确的无线电传播预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid analytical-neural residual surrogate that separates analytically tractable propagation trends—captured by a deterministic baseline of free-space spreading, antenna directivity, modified knife-edge diffraction, and terrain-aware specular reflection—from a compact coarse-to-fine neural network that predicts the residual field, enabling fast radio propagation prediction over irregular terrain.
